title: Your PC.
Away from home.
lines: Use View PC screen from your device
narration: Away from home, or away from your PC? Cloud relay through Voltura lets your paired phone, tablet, or another computer connect to your Windows PC over the internet. You can use View PC screen to see and work on that PC remotely. Let's set it up before you leave.

title: Keep your
PC available.
lines: Leave Voltura Air running and online
narration: Keep the PC powered, connected to the internet, and running Voltura Air. In its tray menu, open Keep awake and choose an interval or Indefinitely. Keep screen on and simulated activity are optional. Keep awake prevents idle sleep while the host runs; it cannot override manual Sleep or closing a laptop lid.
note: Prepare before leaving · Voltura Air cannot wake a sleeping PC

title: Choose
Cloud relay.
lines: No incoming router port to configure
narration: In Voltura Air on your PC, open Connection. Under Connection method, select Cloud relay through Voltura. Both devices connect outward through Voltura, so you don't need to open an incoming router port or firewall exception. Leave Custom relay endpoint unchanged to use Voltura's service.

title: Choose screen
relay quality.
narration: Choose your screen relay quality. Standard uses up to four megabits per second. Data saver lowers that to two; High quality allows up to eight. Lower quality uses less data, which helps on a mobile connection. Screen relay is subject to the service's available allowance, shown on the Connection page.
note: The example has High quality selected · Choose for your connection

title: Save.
Restart.
lines: Wait for Voltura Air to reopen
The selected method must become active
narration: Click Save and restart. Selecting Cloud relay alone does not activate it. Wait for Voltura Air to reopen, then check the relay status on Connection. Next, open Connect on the PC to pair your device using the new relay route.
note: Connection changes take effect after the restart

title: Scan a fresh
pairing code.
lines: Phone: scan the current QR code
narration: On your phone, scan the current QR code from the PC's Connect page and open the detected link. Cloud relay opens the secure controller at voltura dot S E. The code shown here is only a demonstration. Always scan your own PC's fresh code after switching to Relay. If it expires, choose New code and scan again.
note: Demonstration QR only · Scan your own PC's fresh Relay code

title: Name your
device. Pair.
narration: The controller asks you to confirm or edit your device name. Tap Pair, then wait for the connection. Relay may take up to ten seconds to start. The connected controller is shown here. Use this same browser or installed web app later: it remembers the pairing unless its data is cleared or the device is removed.
note: Connected controller shown · No Voltura account required

title: Allow screen
viewing.
narration: Before leaving, open Devices on the PC and select your paired device. Check that View PC screen is allowed. The Remote controls profile blocks screen viewing; use the device's Custom permissions to allow the access you need. Pointer and keyboard permission is also needed to control the PC.
note: Permissions are managed on the PC for each paired device

title: Leave home.
Reconnect.
lines: Use mobile data or another network
Choose the saved PC if prompted
narration: Now try your phone on mobile data or another internet connection. Reopen the same paired controller; keep its tab or bookmark it after pairing. Choose your saved PC and Try reconnect if prompted. Both devices need internet, but they no longer need the same home network. An old Direct LAN bookmark is not the Relay controller.
note: Test the internet connection before relying on remote access

title: Open
View PC screen.
lines: Select the display you want to view
See your PC while away from home
narration: On the connected device, open Menu and choose View PC screen. Select the display you want to view. You can now see your Windows PC over the internet while you're away from home or away from the computer. The preview here uses a fictional desktop inside the real Voltura Air interface.
note: Real View PC screen controls · Fictional demonstration desktop

title: View.
Work remotely.
lines: Sound starts muted: enable if wanted
Leave View PC screen to stop viewing
narration: Use the touch controls, or a mouse and keyboard from another computer, with the required permissions. Sound starts muted; enable it if you want PC audio. One device can view a display at a time. Leave View PC screen to stop viewing. Commands, screen pixels, and PC audio remain encrypted through the relay.
note: Remote access depends on the PC, network, permissions, and relay availability

title: Ready for
remote access.
lines: Pair before leaving · Test screen view
narration: If the PC is unavailable, check that it's awake, online, and still running Voltura Air in Relay mode. Check internet or work-network restrictions, then try reconnecting. A sleeping or shut-down PC cannot be reached. Pair and test before leaving, and find the documentation and troubleshooting guide at voltura dot S E slash air.
note: Based on Voltura Air's connection, pairing, feature, and troubleshooting docs
